title: Private: SSO assertion signer race during KMS envelope rotation causing session attribution and audit gaps (urgent hotpatch)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Multiple enterprise customers reported intermittent cross-session attribution and missing audit events on Private clusters after scheduled KMS envelope rotations. Initial triage indicates the SSO assertion signer occasionally used a recently-rotated envelope key fractionally before rotation metadata propagation completed, producing valid tokens that did not line up with audit indexing and tenant binding logic.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure Private control plane with KMS envelope rotation enabled and SSO (SAML) IdP assertions routed through the assertion-signer service
2) Schedule an envelope rotation (or trigger rotation via KMS API) while many short-lived SSO sessions are being created

3) Observe that some newly minted session tokens reference a key id that is present in KMS but not yet propagated to audit/indexing pipeline, causing audit events to be omitted or associated with a stale tenant binding
4) In rare cases session tokens issued during the narrow window map to incorrect tenant bindings resulting in ephemeral user access confusion and escalations from customers
impact_summary: Customers reported user sessions that appeared as another user/tenant and audit logs missing corresponding assertion events for a subset of sessions created during rotations. Affected customers are on Private (VPC) deployments with aggressive KMS rotation schedules and IdP traffic bursts.
root_cause: Race condition in the assertion-signer service: signer accepted KMS responses for a newly-created envelope key before control-plane metadata and the audit-indexing service had been updated. The key selection logic lacked a propagation-safe barrier and did not tag assertions with deterministic rotation epochs for downstream reconciliation.
workaround: 1) Temporarily disable automatic KMS envelope rotation for affected clusters. 2) Increase assertion-signer validation to require rotation epoch confirmation from control-plane metadata before issuing tokens. 3) For customers reporting incidents, we coordinated a manual audit backfill using KMS key history to reconcile sessions.
mitigation: Hotpatch in progress: add a propagation-safe barrier (rotation-epoch handshake) between KMS rotation and assertion-signer; tag every issued assertion with rotation-epoch and signer-key-id; make audit-indexing treat assertions without epoch as 'stale' and queue them for reconciliation. Patch also adds defensive checks to reject issuance if control-plane confirms incomplete rotation propagation.
comments: 2026-03-10 Marcus Chen: Triage complete. Repro on staging with synthetic rotation traffic. Impact qualifies P0 due to cross-tenant exposure possibility.
2026-03-11 Asha Patel (PM): Notified three affected customers; scheduled emergency call with customer security teams. Prioritize hotpatch and rollback plan.
2026-03-12 Marcus Chen: Implemented epoch-tagging prototype; unit tests added for propagation handshake. Opening PR for review.
2026-03-13 Security Review (requested): Required — awaiting expedited security signoff for hotpatch deployment into private clusters. Need legal/infosec approval for audit backfill script.
2026-03-14 Marcus Chen: Hotpatch PR submitted (see links). Staged deploy in one low-traffic private cluster for canary; monitoring auth-success rates and audit ingestion lag.

2026-03-14 Elena Ruiz (SRE): Canary shows reduction in missing audit events and no further cross-tenant attributions in the test window. Proceeding with rolling patch but keeping rotation disabled until 03/17 as a safety window.
postmortem_action_items: 1) Add end-to-end integration tests for KMS rotation + signers + audit-indexing pipeline
2) Implement automatic reconciliation job that uses rotation-epoch and KMS key history to backfill missing audit events
3) Update Private deployment runbook to include rotation propagation checks and a pre-rotation gating mechanism
4) Customer communication playbook to proactively inform on rotation-related risks and mitigation steps
